note: Faction-neutral subjects (terrain and resources). Factions never change terrain; the terrain recipe class also omits the faction layer.

subjects.TERRAIN:GRASS: Subject: a wide flat meadow of short lawn grass seen from directly above, one even calm mid-green base colour with small darker grass tufts scattered evenly and sparsely all over, nothing else.
subjects.TERRAIN:FOREST: Subject: a dense clump of three or four chunky round-crowned trees and one pine packed tightly together, muted deep green and olive leaves in big simple blobs, short dark grey-brown trunks, the clump as wide as the image; the tree trunks are the lowest thing in the image, with no ground, no grass patch, no soil and no shadow under them.
subjects.TERRAIN:MOUNTAIN: Subject: a chunky rocky mountain, just rock and snow: two or three steep cool grey stone peaks with small white snow caps, big simple rock faces in two grey tones, the mountain as wide as the image; no face, no eyes, no creature, no boulders at the foot; the foot of the rock is the lowest thing in the image, with no ground, no grass patch, no soil and no shadow around it.
subjects.TERRAIN:SHALLOW_WATER: Subject: a flat seamless water texture of calm shallow lagoon seen from directly above: one flat even light turquoise colour everywhere, with a few tiny pale wave ripple marks scattered evenly and sparsely, nothing else; open water only, no land anywhere.
subjects.TERRAIN:DEEP_WATER: Subject: a flat seamless water texture of calm deep open sea seen from directly above: one flat even deep blue colour everywhere, with a few tiny lighter wave marks scattered evenly and sparsely, nothing else; open water only, no land anywhere.
